from: We rarely see such a fast approval.

ok.de: Richtig: Rarely do we see such a fast approval. Am Satzanfang steht das Hilfsverb vor dem Subjekt.
ok.en: Right: Rarely do we see such a fast approval. At the start the auxiliary comes before the subject.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort rarely muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word rarely must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach rarely am Satzanfang kommt do vor das Subjekt: Rarely do we …
wrong.en: After rarely at the start, do goes before the subject: Rarely do we …

from: He had never seen such a mess before.

ok.de: Richtig: Never had he seen such a mess before. Das Hilfsverb had steht vor dem Subjekt.
ok.en: Right: Never had he seen such a mess before. The auxiliary had goes before the subject.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort never muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word never must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach never am Satzanfang kommt had vor das Subjekt: Never had he seen …
wrong.en: After never at the start, had goes before the subject: Never had he seen …

from: We will start only when the client signs.
frame: ___ the client signs will we start.

ok.de: Richtig: Only when the client signs will we start. Im Hauptsatz steht will vor we.
ok.en: Right: Only when the client signs will we start. In the main clause will goes before we.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort only muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word only must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Ohne only fehlt die Betonung. Die Lücke braucht Only when.
wrong.en: Without only the stress is missing. The gap needs Only when.

from: The full rollout was approved only after the pilot.
frame: ___ the pilot was the full rollout approved.

ok.de: Richtig: Only after the pilot was the full rollout approved. Hinter Only after steht die Umstellung.
ok.en: Right: Only after the pilot was the full rollout approved. The inversion follows Only after.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort only muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word only must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort only gehört an den Anfang.
wrong.en: The key word only belongs at the start.

from: As soon as we signed the contract, the prices rose.
frame: ___ had we signed the contract than the prices rose.

ok.de: Richtig: No sooner had we signed the contract than the prices rose. Auf no sooner folgt than.
ok.en: Right: No sooner had we signed the contract than the prices rose. No sooner is followed by than.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort sooner muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word sooner must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Es heißt no sooner, mit no.
wrong.en: It is no sooner, with no.

from: We had barely finished the call when the client rang again.
frame: ___ we finished the call when the client rang again.

ok.de: Richtig: Hardly had we finished the call when the client rang again. Zu hardly passt when.
ok.en: Right: Hardly had we finished the call when the client rang again. Hardly goes with when.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort hardly muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word hardly must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort hardly muss vorn stehen.
wrong.en: The key word hardly must come first.

from: If you require assistance, please write to us.
frame: ___ require assistance, please write to us.

ok.de: Richtig: Should you require assistance, … Should ersetzt das if, danach steht die Grundform.
ok.en: Right: Should you require assistance, … Should replaces the if, and the base form follows.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort should muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word should must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach Should you steht kein will, nur die Grundform.
wrong.en: After Should you there is no will, only the base form.

from: If we had known about the outage, we would have warned you.
frame: ___ about the outage, we would have warned you.

ok.de: Richtig: Had we known about the outage, … Had ersetzt das if, das Subjekt folgt direkt.
ok.en: Right: Had we known about the outage, … Had replaces the if, and the subject follows directly.

wrong.de: Das Schlüsselwort had muss unverändert in der Lücke stehen.
wrong.en: The key word had must stay unchanged in the gap.

wrong.de: Nach Had folgt das Subjekt we: Had we known.
wrong.en: After Had comes the subject we: Had we known.

prompt: Seldom we receive feedback this quickly.
fixed: Seldom do we receive feedback this quickly.

ok.de: Der Fehler: nach Seldom am Anfang fehlt do vor dem Subjekt. Richtig: Seldom do we receive …
ok.en: The error: after Seldom at the start, do is missing before the subject. Correct: Seldom do we receive …

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach Seldom kommt das Hilfsverb vor das Subjekt.
wrong.en: There is an error: After Seldom the auxiliary comes before the subject.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Nach Seldom kommt das Hilfsverb vor das Subjekt.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: After Seldom the auxiliary comes before the subject.

prompt: Little did the board know about the real costs.

ok.de: Richtig: Little did the board know … Nach Little am Anfang steht did vor dem Subjekt.
ok.en: Right: Little did the board know … After Little at the start, did stands before the subject.

wrong.de: Hier ist alles richtig: Little did the board know ist richtig umgestellt.
wrong.en: Everything is right here: Little did the board know is correctly inverted.

prompt: Only after the test phase we released the update.
fixed: Only after the test phase did we release the update.

ok.de: Der Fehler: nach Only after fehlt die Umstellung. Richtig: Only after the test phase did we release …
ok.en: The error: after Only after the inversion is missing. Correct: Only after the test phase did we release …

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach Only after steht das Hilfsverb vor dem Subjekt.
wrong.en: There is an error: After Only after the auxiliary comes before the subject.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Nach Only after steht das Hilfsverb vor dem Subjekt.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: After Only after the auxiliary comes before the subject.

prompt: Only when the client signs we will start the work.
fixed: Only when the client signs will we start the work.

ok.de: Der Fehler: im Hauptsatz steht will vor dem Subjekt. Richtig: Only when the client signs will we start …
ok.en: The error: in the main clause will goes before the subject. Correct: Only when the client signs will we start …

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Im Hauptsatz nach Only when kommt das Hilfsverb zuerst.
wrong.en: There is an error: In the main clause after Only when the auxiliary comes first.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Im Hauptsatz nach Only when kommt das Hilfsverb zuerst.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: In the main clause after Only when the auxiliary comes first.

prompt: No sooner had we left the office when the storm began.
fixed: No sooner had we left the office than the storm began.

ok.de: Der Fehler: zu no sooner gehört than, nicht when. Richtig: No sooner had we left the office than …
ok.en: The error: no sooner goes with than, not when. Correct: No sooner had we left the office than …

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Zu no sooner gehört than.
wrong.en: There is an error: No sooner goes with than.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Zu no sooner gehört than.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: No sooner goes with than.

prompt: Hardly we had started the call when the line dropped.
fixed: Hardly had we started the call when the line dropped.

ok.de: Der Fehler: nach Hardly steht had vor dem Subjekt. Richtig: Hardly had we started the call …
ok.en: The error: after Hardly, had goes before the subject. Correct: Hardly had we started the call …

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach Hardly kommt das Hilfsverb vor das Subjekt.
wrong.en: There is an error: After Hardly the auxiliary comes before the subject.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Nach Hardly kommt das Hilfsverb vor das Subjekt.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: After Hardly the auxiliary comes before the subject.

prompt: Should you will need support, please contact the help desk.
fixed: Should you need support, please contact the help desk.

ok.de: Der Fehler: nach Should you steht die Grundform ohne will. Richtig: Should you need support, …
ok.en: The error: after Should you the base form follows without will. Correct: Should you need support, …

wrong.de: Doch, hier steckt ein Fehler: Nach Should you steht die Grundform.
wrong.en: There is an error: After Should you comes the base form.

wrong.de: Der Fehler liegt woanders: Nach Should you steht die Grundform.
wrong.en: The error is elsewhere: After Should you comes the base form.

prompt: Had the team known about the delay, they would have called us.

ok.de: Richtig: Had the team known … ersetzt das If the team had known.
ok.en: Right: Had the team known … replaces If the team had known.

wrong.de: Hier ist alles richtig: Had the team known ist richtig gebildet.
wrong.en: Everything is right here: Had the team known is correctly formed.

a: Never have I seen such a clear plan.
b: I have never seen such a clear plan.

q.de: Welcher Satz betont stärker, dass es so etwas noch nie gab?
q.en: Which sentence stresses more that this has never happened before?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz a. Die Umstellung nach Never hebt die Aussage stärker hervor.
ok.en: Right: sentence a. The inversion after Never makes the statement stronger.

wrong.de: In b steht dasselbe ohne Umstellung. Es ist sachlich, nicht betont.
wrong.en: Sentence b says the same without inversion. It is neutral, not stressed.

wrong.de: Nicht gleich stark: Nur a ist betont.
wrong.en: Not equally strong: only a is stressed.

a: Only after the audit did we change the process.
b: We changed the process before the audit.

q.de: Welcher Satz sagt, dass der Prozess erst nach der Prüfung geändert wurde?
q.en: Which sentence says the process was changed only after the audit?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz a. Only after heißt „erst nach“.
ok.en: Right: sentence a. Only after means “not until after”.

wrong.de: In b geschieht die Änderung vor der Prüfung, das ist das Gegenteil.
wrong.en: In b the change happens before the audit, which is the opposite.

wrong.de: Die beiden Sätze sagen Gegenteiliges.
wrong.en: The two sentences say opposite things.

a: No sooner had she left than the phone rang.
b: She left a long time after the phone rang.

q.de: Welcher Satz sagt, dass das Telefon gleich nach ihrem Weggang klingelte?
q.en: Which sentence says the phone rang right after she left?

ok.de: Richtig: Satz a. No sooner … than heißt „kaum … da“, es ist fast gleichzeitig.
ok.en: Right: sentence a. No sooner … than means “hardly … when”: almost at once.

wrong.de: In b klingelt das Telefon lange vor ihrem Weggang. Das ist die falsche Reihenfolge.
wrong.en: In b the phone rings long before she leaves. That is the wrong order.

wrong.de: Die Reihenfolge der beiden Sätze ist verschieden.
wrong.en: The order of events differs between the two sentences.

a: Had we known, we would have acted.
b: If we had known, we would have acted.

q.en: Do both sentences mean the same?

ok.de: Richtig: beide. Had we known ersetzt If we had known, nur förmlicher.
ok.en: Right: both. Had we known replaces If we had known, just more formally.

wrong.de: Nicht nur a: b sagt mit if dasselbe.
wrong.en: Not only a: b says the same with if.

wrong.de: Nicht nur b: a sagt ohne if dasselbe.
wrong.en: Not only b: a says the same without if.
